target.definition: Turnover of Taiwan's food and beverage services industry in September 2026, in current prices, as first reported by the Ministry of Economic Affairs Department of Statistics.

inputs.name: annual_food_service_turnover_2025
inputs.description: Total food and beverage services industry turnover in Taiwan for calendar year 2025.

provenance.rationale: Extrapolated from recent MOEA annual food service turnover (~TWD 1.0 trillion in 2024) with modest growth.

inputs.name: september_share_of_annual
inputs.description: Fraction of annual food service turnover occurring in September.

provenance.rationale: September is a typical month; share near 1/12 with slight seasonal variation.

inputs.name: monthly_growth_factor_2025_to_2026
inputs.description: Year-over-year growth factor for food service turnover from 2025 to 2026.

provenance.rationale: Recent nominal growth has been 3–8%; 4% central with uncertainty.

inputs.name: september_2025_turnover
inputs.description: Food and beverage services turnover in September 2025 as reported by MOEA.

provenance.rationale: Based on recent monthly levels around TWD 80–90 billion.

inputs.name: yoy_growth_factor_sep
inputs.description: Year-over-year growth factor for September food service turnover.

provenance.rationale: Similar to annual growth assumption.

inputs.name: number_of_food_service_establishments
inputs.description: Number of food and beverage service establishments in Taiwan.

provenance.rationale: Taiwan has roughly 150k–170k food service businesses including small vendors.

inputs.name: average_monthly_turnover_per_establishment
inputs.description: Average monthly turnover per food service establishment.

provenance.rationale: Implied by annual turnover ~1e12 TWD / (160k * 12) ≈ 520k TWD.

inputs.name: september_seasonal_factor
inputs.description: Multiplicative factor for September relative to an average month.

provenance.rationale: September is near average; small seasonal effect.

inputs.name: household_consumption_expenditure_on_food_service
inputs.description: Taiwan household final consumption expenditure on restaurants and hotels (proxy for food service) in 2025.

provenance.rationale: DGBAS national accounts: household consumption on restaurants/hotels is roughly TWD 1.2 trillion.

inputs.name: food_service_share_of_restaurant_hotel_consumption
inputs.description: Share of restaurant and hotel household consumption attributable to food and beverage services.

provenance.rationale: Hotels are a small part; food service dominates.

inputs.name: september_share_of_annual_consumption
inputs.description: Fraction of annual household consumption on restaurants/hotels occurring in September.

provenance.rationale: Uniform monthly distribution with slight variation.

inputs.name: consumption_growth_factor_2025_to_2026
inputs.description: Growth factor for household consumption on restaurants/hotels from 2025 to 2026.

provenance.rationale: Nominal growth in line with GDP and inflation.

paths.description: Allocate annual food service turnover to September and apply growth.
Count establishments and multiply by average monthly turnover, adjusted for September seasonality and growth.
Scale household consumption on restaurants/hotels to food service September turnover.

problems: path p2: dimension mismatch: the formula gives count per time (s**-1), but the target needs a pure number, a count or a share (dimensionless). The formula has one 'per time' more than the target; inputs with a time unit in this path: average_monthly_turnover_per_establishment ('TWD/establishment/month'). If the target is a total over a period, multiply by an input whose unit is a length of time: the period itself (for example days_in_period with unit 'day'), or period_length = 1 with unit 'year' when a share of the year then picks the part you need. A share, or a ratio such as 'days/year', has no time unit and does not cancel it.
